d: Pradhanmantri narendr modi ne aasiyan deshon ke sath bharat ke sanbandhon ko aur pragarh banane par jor diya hai. aasiyan shikhar sammelan ko sanbodhit karte hue pradhanmantri ne kaha ki bharat ka vikas aur aasiyan ki samriddhi ek-dusre se jure hue hain. unhonne kshetriy sahyog, aarthik sajhedari aur sajha vikas ke mahatv ko rekhankit kiya. vahin, jharkhand vidhanasbha ke sthapna divas samaroh ko lekar taiyariyan tej ho gaee hain. vidhanasbha adhyaksh ne rajyapal santosh kumar gangvar se mulakat kar unhen sthapna divas samaroh men shamil hone ka aamantran diya. rajy sthapna divas pakhvara…
